description:
Project: Safe apply + rollback mechanism (Cost Optimization Automation: batching, caching, quantization profiles).

Goal
- Reduce change-failure risk from optimization/config changes (batching heuristics, cache toggles, quantization profiles) by introducing config versioning + safe apply workflows and a one-click rollback.
- Make every optimization change traceable (who/what/when), reversible, and gated by health/quality signals.

Scope
- Versioned “Optimization Config” objects stored in the platform control plane (immutable versions with metadata, diff view, and promotion semantics).
- Safe apply workflow:
  - Validate config (schema + semantic checks).
  - Apply via staged rollout (tenant/model/region scope) with optional canary percentage.
  - Gate progression on SLO metrics (5xx, p95/p99 latency) and, for quantization, quality signals from the eval harness.
- Rollback workflow:
  - One-click rollback in Console + API endpoint to revert to a prior known-good version.
  - Idempotent runtime config applier and safeguards against race conditions.
- Auditability + access control:
  - Audit log events for config create/apply/promote/rollback.
  - RBAC permissions for “optimization change operator” roles.
- Deployment coverage:
  - Hosted + Dedicated: managed by Redwood control plane.
  - Private: supports the same versioning model and an operator-friendly rollback procedure (installer/helm/terraform integration).

Out of scope (initially)
- Fully automated rollback without human confirmation for all customers (only for limited internal/selected accounts in early phases).
- Complex multi-config transactional rollbacks across unrelated subsystems.

Timeline (plausible)
- Discovery & design (2025-09 to 2025-10): PRD + design spec + ADRs; define audit/RBAC + gating metrics.
- Build (2025-11 to 2026-01): control plane versioning, runtime applier, Console UX, CI/e2e tests, dashboards.
- Internal beta + gamedays (2026-01): validate rollback reliability and race-condition handling.
- Limited GA (2026-02 to 2026-03): rollout to selected Hosted/Dedicated accounts; Private documentation + installer support.

Key deliverables
- Optimization Config Service (versioning, diff, validation, apply/rollback APIs)
- Console: config history, diff view, rollback button with confirmation + blast-radius summary
- Runtime: idempotent config application and safe rollback
- SRE: dashboards/alerts + runbooks + gameday plan
- Security: audit event taxonomy + RBAC policy bundle updates
- Release readiness checklist + post-incident learnings baked into standard change management
